messages:
maria_cs: Kite Labs reserved capacity kickoff for day-0 ramp. ETA 09:00 PT tomorrow. Need quota checks, autoscale policy, and a 30-min shadow load test. Who's on call?
raj_eng: I can take quota + model pinning. Will validate slot sizes. @taylor_sre can you confirm RB autoscale policy?
taylor_sre: Confirmed. Policy I'll apply:
```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 20
target_utilization: 0.65
cooldown_secs: 60
```
Will open PR shortly.
lee_ml: For model variant use `redwood/ops-bert-q4`, fallback `bert-fp16`. Pre-warmed KV cache with small prefix set.
opsbot: deploy job queued: deploy/dedicated/kite-labs slot=5 user=sam_ce
sam_ce: I'll run the 30m shadow. Plan: ramp 5->40 QPS in 10m steps, 30m steady. Script ready.
maria_cs: Quick checklist: 1) quota comp 2) autoscale PR 3) load script 4) alert thresholds 5) billing tags
raj_eng: quota comp done. Reserved tokens bumped to 2.5M/day and model pinned. PR: https://github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/789
taylor_sre: PR merged and applied. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.com/kite-labs-capacity
lee_ml: KV pre-warm status: hit_rate=98% sample. Command used: `kv_warm --prefix kite_beta --concurrency 8`
sam_ce: Starting shadow now: `./scripts/shadow_load --target 40 --duration 30m --pattern ramp` :rocket:
opsbot: shadow-run-1791234560 started by sam_ce
taylor_sre: Alerting set: p95_latency_ms > 1200 -> page, error_rate > 0.7% -> page. Config snippet:
`alerts: {p95:1200, err_pct:0.7, window:60s}`
maria_cs: If p95 spikes, fallback to `bert-fp16` and enable rate limit 30rps per-key. @sam_ce abort if errors > 0.7% for 3m
sam_ce: Ack :thumbsup:
opsbot: shadow-run-1791234560 complete. Summary: peak_qps=38, p95_latency_ms=430, error_rate=0.2%, est_cost_delta=+3%
maria_cs: Great. Next: schedule 4h soak next Tue, add traffic patterns to renewal playbook, and capture customer feedback for first 48h.
